# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers iterative UI changes: add elements step by step rather than all at once, and the use of color/heading variations is only for easily recognizing UI changes during verification. Confidence: 0.94
- User prefers code identifiers/names in English, even when conversation is in Polish. Confidence: 0.98
- User prefers proper English method/identifier names and does not want placeholder names or one-to-one transliterations in code, especially for UI actions like UserInput handlers.
